verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email-and-calendar service, so sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting slots into an email is a fair question for it. The pack offers only a bare 'Calendar events and invitations' help-article title and a community comment about calendar sync to Google. Neither is about availability sharing or booking links, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
